why_angle: The cited guides list EcoFlow models but never say which ones can take extra batteries. Solarkontor only says the older RIVER Pro and DELTA Max/Pro expand. None of them separates the fixed DELTA 3 Max, DELTA 3 Ultra and DELTA 3000 Gen4 from the expandable Plus and 3800 Gen4 versions, or mentions EcoFlow's short list of models that can auto-start the Smart Generator. That choice has to be made before buying, because a fixed unit stays at its built-in capacity for life.
must: For most homes, the DELTA 3 Plus

page.title: Which EcoFlow Power Station Should You Buy? Start With Whether You'll Add Batteries
page.h1: Which EcoFlow power station should you buy?
page.desc: Which EcoFlow power station to buy for each need: lab-measured usable energy, idle draw, and which models can add batteries later, with EcoFlow store prices.
page.answer: Short answer. Which EcoFlow power station should you buy? For most homes, the DELTA 3 Plus: StorageReview measured 910 Wh usable and an 8 ms switchover, and it grows to 5 kWh. The DELTA 3 Max and DELTA 3 Ultra can never add a battery; only their Plus versions can.

cells.fits: Home backup you may grow later; fast-switching backup for a desk PC or NAS
cells.expand: Yes, to 5 kWh; on the Smart Generator 3000 auto start-stop list (StorageReview; EcoFlow, read 2026-11-15)
cells.measured: 910 Wh delivered (88.9%); switchover just over 8 ms (StorageReview, read 2026-11-15)

cells.fits: Same 1 kWh size and same expansion path as the Plus
cells.expand: Yes, 1–5 kWh; on the Smart Generator 3000 auto start-stop list (OutdoorGearLab; EcoFlow, read 2026-11-15)
cells.measured: 870 Wh usable (85%); full AC charge in about 50 min (OutdoorGearLab, read 2026-11-15)

cells.fits: Light loads under 300 W you carry by hand; 7.8 lb (StorageReview)
cells.expand: No extra battery listed for it: EcoFlow's RIVER extra battery names only the RIVER 3 Plus (EcoFlow, read 2026-11-15)
cells.measured: 210 Wh delivered at a 300 W load (85.7%) (StorageReview, read 2026-11-15)

cells.fits: 2 kWh you will never expand; 45 lb (The Solar Lab)
cells.expand: No: 'cannot connect to extra batteries' (The Solar Lab, read 2026-11-15)
cells.measured: 0–100% on AC in 68 min; 79% efficiency; about 27 W idle (The Solar Lab, read 2026-11-15)

cells.fits: 3 kWh and 3,600 W bought on Amazon, recharged from the wall or a generator; true 30 A RV outlet (The Solar Lab)

page.after:
What the differences mean

Dealectric does not test units. The measurements below come from the named labs. The sums are ours, one line each.

  • Expect 85–93% of the rated capacity at the outlet. DELTA 3 Plus: 910 ÷ 1,024 Wh = 88.9% (StorageReview). DELTA 3: 870 ÷ 1,024 Wh = 85% (OutdoorGearLab). RIVER 3: 210 ÷ 245 Wh = 85.7% (StorageReview). DELTA Pro 3: 3,790 ÷ 4,096 Wh = 92.5% (OutdoorGearLab).
  • Wall to outlet. DELTA 3 Plus: 910 Wh out ÷ 1,180 Wh from the wall = 77.1% (from StorageReview's two readings).
  • Idle drain. DELTA 3 Ultra: 3,072 Wh ÷ 22 W = 140 h, about 5.8 days with nothing plugged in (The Solar Lab's idle reading). DELTA 3 Max: 2,048 Wh ÷ 27 W = 76 h, about 3.2 days.
  • What the Plus costs at 2 kWh. $1,149 − $879 = $270 at EcoFlow's US store on 2026-11-15. That buys room for batteries up to 10 kWh, plus 3,000 W of output instead of 2,400 W.
  • Weight at 3 kWh. DELTA 3 Ultra 72 lb (The Solar Lab) − DELTA 3000 Gen4 57.3 lb (Popular Science) = 14.7 lb.
Your needBuy
Phones, laptops and lights under 300 W, carried by handRIVER 3
About 1 kWh now with room to grow; backup for a desk PC or NASDELTA 3 Plus or DELTA 3
2 kWh you will never expandDELTA 3 Max
2 kWh that can grow to 10 kWhDELTA 3 Max Plus
3 kWh and 3,600 W bought on Amazon, charged from the wallDELTA 3 Ultra
3 kWh and 3,600 W bought from EcoFlow's storeDELTA 3000 Gen4
3–4 kWh now, with batteries or heavy solar laterDELTA 3 Ultra Plus or DELTA 3800 Gen4
240 V loads or a whole-home systemDELTA Pro 3 or DELTA Pro Ultra

In these sources the DELTA 3 Plus and DELTA 3 share 1,024 Wh, 1,800 W, 500 W solar input and the 5 kWh limit, so buy whichever is cheaper that day. The Plus is listed first only because StorageReview timed its switchover at just over 8 ms. None of the labs here timed the DELTA 3's. {buy:ecoflow-delta-3-plus-1024wh}

Which EcoFlow models can add batteries later

At 2 kWh and 3 kWh, EcoFlow sells a fixed model next to an expandable one. The fixed one keeps its built-in battery and can never take more, so decide before you buy.

  • DELTA 3 Max: The Solar Lab says it 'cannot connect to extra batteries'. EcoFlow's DELTA 3 Max Plus listing claims 2–10 kWh and 3,000 W.
  • DELTA 3 Ultra: The Solar Lab lists it as non-expandable. The DELTA 3 Ultra Plus (3,072 Wh, 3,600 W, $1,599 at EcoFlow's store) claims 3–11 kWh.
  • DELTA 3000 Gen4: Popular Science notes its spec sheet 'lists no battery port'. The DELTA 3800 Gen4 ($1,699 at EcoFlow's store) claims 4–12 kWh.
  • Which DELTAs the 2,048 Wh extra battery fits: the DELTA 3 Max Plus Smart Extra Battery ($859 at EcoFlow's store) names only the DELTA 3 Max Plus, DELTA 3 Ultra Plus and DELTA Gen4 3800.
  • Generator auto start-stop: EcoFlow's Smart Generator 3000 page limits automatic start-stop to the DELTA 3, DELTA 3 Plus and DELTA 3 Ultra Plus. The DELTA 3 Max Plus listing also claims automatic start-stop with 'an EcoFlow Smart Generator' but does not say which one.
  • 1 kWh: the DELTA 3 and DELTA 3 Plus grow to 5 kWh with DELTA 3, DELTA 2, DELTA 2 Max or DELTA Pro 3 extra batteries (EcoFlow; StorageReview). The DELTA 3 Classic's page claims no expansion.
  • Small units: EcoFlow's RIVER extra battery fits only the RIVER 3 Plus, which reaches up to 858 Wh with it. EcoFlow lists no extra battery for the RIVER 3.
  • Big units: the DELTA Pro 3 grows to 48 kWh (OutdoorGearLab) and the DELTA Pro Ultra to 90 kWh (EcoFlow). On 2026-11-15, EcoFlow's US store listed the DELTA Pro 3 as unavailable until late January and the DELTA Pro Ultra as unavailable.

Not recommended

The DELTA 3 Ultra for solar-first use, for adding batteries later, or bought from EcoFlow's own store. Its solar input is rated 800 W. The Solar Lab reports that on a 1,000 W array it 'made a strange sound and then started to smoke', twice. It can't take extra batteries, it can't auto-start the Smart Generator 3000, and it idles at about 22 W. At EcoFlow's store the DELTA 3000 Gen4 costs the same, takes 1,000 W of solar and weighs 14.7 lb less. The Ultra does win in three places: The Solar Lab charged it from 0 to 100% in 2 h on a household outlet, it has a true 30 A RV outlet, and on 2026-11-15 it cost less than the DELTA 3000 Gen4 on Amazon. {buy:ecoflow-delta-3-ultra}
